views.alt: Cloudflare's deploy form, with no Git account yet

steps.html: In Cloudflare's form, find Git account. Click New GitHub connection.

views.alt: GitHub asking to install and authorize Cloudflare Workers and Pages

steps.html: GitHub asks to install Cloudflare Workers and Pages. Keep All repositories selected.
Click Install & Authorize.

views.alt: Cloudflare's own Select a repository page

steps.html: Cloudflare opens a page called Select a repository. You do not need it. Close this tab.

views.alt: The deploy form with a GitHub account picked, the project name, SETUP_MODE and the Deploy button

steps.html: Go back to this setup page. Click Deploy to Cloudflare again. Under Git account, choose your GitHub account. Do not change anything else.
Click Deploy. Keep this tab open. You do the next step in it.

views.alt: The finished build in Cloudflare, with its green tick

steps.html: Wait about one minute for the build. When you see a green tick (Success), reload the page.

views.alt: The Worker's page in the Cloudflare dashboard, with its Visit button

steps.html: Click Visit (top right). This opens your Worker, at https://comfy-gen.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev. Save it as a bookmark. Then you can close the Cloudflare tab.

views.alt: Cloudflare's Create Token page, filled in, with the Continue to summary button

steps.html: Everything is already filled in. Only if your Cloudflare login has more than one account (for example, one from work): change All accounts to your own account.
Scroll down. Click Continue to summary.

views.alt: The token summary, with the Create Token button

steps.html: Click Create Token.

views.alt: The new token, shown once, with its copy button

steps.html: Click the copy button at the end of the token. Paste it in the box below. Then you can close the Cloudflare tab.

views.alt: R2's page before it is turned on, with the Add R2 subscription to my account button

steps.html: Click Add R2 subscription to my account. It costs $0. If your account has no card, Cloudflare asks you to add one first. Then you can close the Cloudflare tab.

views.alt: The Cloudflare dashboard's sidebar, with Manage account open

steps.html: In the Cloudflare dashboard, open Manage account in the left menu.
Then open Billing.

views.alt: Cloudflare's billing page, on Billable usage

steps.html: Open Billable usage.
Then open Budget alerts.

views.alt: Cloudflare's default $10 budget alert

steps.html: Cloudflare already made a $10 alert. To change the amount, click the pencil icon. The alert only sends you an email. It never stops anything.

views.alt: Modal's Usage & billing settings, with Manage payment details

steps.html: In Modal, open Settings → Usage & billing. Click Manage payment details and add a card.

views.alt: Modal's Usage limit tab, with Edit spend limit

steps.html: In Settings → Usage & billing, open the Usage limit tab.
Click Edit spend limit. After the free credits, Modal stops all work at this amount. With $0, you never pay more than the free credits.

views.alt: Modal's API tokens settings, with the New Token button

steps.html: Open Modal's API tokens page (Settings → API tokens & service users). Click New Token.

views.alt: Modal's New token dialog

steps.html: Click Create token.

views.alt: The new token, inside a modal token set command

steps.html: Modal shows the token only once, inside a command. Copy the whole command (move the mouse over it to see the copy button). On your Worker's page, paste it into the box Paste the command here. Then you can close the Modal tab.

views.alt: claude.ai's Customize, on Connectors

steps.html: In claude.ai, click Customize in the left menu.
Open Connectors.

views.alt: The Add menu, with Add custom connector

steps.html: Click Add.
Then click Add custom connector.

views.alt: The Add custom connector dialog, empty

steps.html: For the name, type Comfy-Gen.
Paste your connector URL. (On your Worker's page, Copy URL copies it.)
Click Continue.

views.alt: The dialog's second page, with No sign-in picked

steps.html: Scroll down. Click Add.

views.alt: The new connector's page, with its Connect button

steps.html: Click Connect.

views.alt: A new chat's + menu

steps.html: In a chat, click +.

views.alt: The Connectors submenu, with the connector turned on

steps.html: Open Connectors.
Turn your connector on.
Ask for an image. The first time, Claude asks if it may use the tool. Choose Always allow.

views.alt: The agent's page, with the Pairing link field and the Pair button

steps.html: The agent's page opens in your browser. Paste the pairing link into Pairing link. (On your Worker's page, Copy link copies it.) It pairs by itself. If it does not, click Pair.
